patterns.title: Authorization preservation under a sound policy slice
patterns.property: For fixed request and entities, a slice satisfying IsSoundPolicySlice produces the same isAuthorized result as the original policy set.

source_to_proof_to_check.property: isAuthorized req entities slice = isAuthorized req entities policies

check.interpretation: Compilation coverage at the pinned source revision. No local independent replay or axiom/trust inspection is recorded.

patterns.reuse_use_case: A downstream policy analyzer can prove that its request-specific selected policies satisfy the source sound-slice predicate and then reuse the equality to justify evaluating only that slice.
gaps: The result is indexed with the upstream Cedar Lean dependency closure; a standalone handoff package was not prepared.
